value.rationale: The quantitative jump of a diagonal C0-semigroup is a natural invariant measuring failure of norm continuity, which the motivating 2026 Lotz argument leaves qualitative. The new general equality identifies its asymptotic geometric control via tail projection constants. The monotone-basis realization supplies every intermediate jump amplitude and full cluster set on a standard space while preserving positivity, contractivity, exponential stability and immediate compactness. This is a complete sharp realization for a motivated invariant, not an arbitrary finite-dimensional slice or a restatement of the generator unboundedness.
